def dedupe_keep_order(items: list) -> list:
    seen = set()
    return [item for item in items if not (item in seen or seen.add(item))]
```

def is_palindrome(s: str) -> bool:
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if c.isalnum()).lower()
    return s == s[::-1]

from collections import Counter
import re

def top_words(text: str, n: int) -> list:
    words = re.findall(r'\b\w+\b', text.lower())
    return [word for word, _ in Counter(words).most_common(n)]

def flatten(nested: list) -> list:
    """Flattens arbitrarily nested lists into one list."""
    return [item for sublist in nested for item in (flatten(sublist) if isinstance(sublist, list) else [sublist])] if any(isinstance(i, list) for i in nested) else nested
```

def chunk(items: list, size: int) -> list:
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]
